lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Roughly equidistant rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in vertical columns across the posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern on the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear horizontal feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, showing a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, elongated horizontal white scar or depigmented lesion is visible on the lower posterior flank.
